## LXG-04 Reply Handler (webhook)
Receives Instantly events. URL: `https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/lxg-instantly-events?token=<INSTANTLY_WEBHOOK_SECRET>`
• **reply** → status REPLIED + reply date/meta (Instantly stops the sequence natively) → optional acknowledgement
• **unsubscribe / opt-out reply** → UNSUBSCRIBED + added to **Suppression**
• **email sent** → CONTACTED / FOLLOW_UP_PENDING / COMPLETED
• **bounce** → STOPPED + suppressed

Acknowledgement is OFF unless `ACK_ENABLED=true`, `DRY_RUN=false` and client copy is set in *Decide Action*.
